# H.264 fixture

`synthetic_red.h264` is a recorded synthetic 64×48 red IDR image generated by
`scripts/make_h264_fixture.py` using libx264 through PyAV. It is project-generated
test data, not an A8 camera capture. Tests extract its SPS/PPS for SDP, packetize
its NAL units, and check decoded dimensions and red pixel values using real PyAV.
